## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes locally (fmt, clippy native and wasm32, tests, cargo deny, WASM build, Vitest)
- [ ] Wire-format or key-derivation changes are specified in [tavrn-protocol](https://github.com/just-tavrn/tavrn-protocol) first, and the test vectors are updated there
- [ ] New source files carry the SPDX header `// SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0`
- [ ] No secrets, keys or private hosts in code, tests or logs
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](https://github.com/just-tavrn/tavrn-crypto/blob/main/CLA.md) (the CLA bot asks on your first pull request)
